title: Algebraic one-step survival bound
statement:
Let $c$, $n$, and $m$ be natural numbers with $n \ge 2$, $m > 0$, and $cn \le 2m$. Then the one-step survival probability $1 - \frac{c}{m}$ satisfies
\[
  \frac{n-2}{n} \;\le\; 1 - \frac{c}{m}.
\]
replaced:
For naturals $c, n, m$ with $2 \le n$, $0 < m$ and $c\,n \le 2m$, the survival probability
$1 - c/m$ satisfies
\[
  \frac{n-2}{n} \;\le\; 1 - \frac{c}{m}.
\]
